description: MCP server for the Avito Ads API: campaigns, ad groups, creatives, statistics and balances.
name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-avito-ads

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client id of your Avito application (grant_type=client_credentials).
environmentVariables.name: AVITO_ADS_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret of your Avito application. Treat it as a secret.
environmentVariables.name: AVITO_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Ad account id (positive integer) every request is scoped to.
environmentVariables.name: AVITO_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Which API to talk to: production or sandbox.
environmentVariables.name: AVITO_ADS_ENVIRONMENT

environmentVariables.description: API root override, replacing host and environment prefix (e.g. a local mock).
environmentVariables.name: AVITO_ADS_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Retries on 429 (always) and on 5xx / network errors for reads only.
environmentVariables.name: AVITO_ADS_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: Refresh the OAuth2 token this many seconds before it expires.
environmentVariables.name: AVITO_ADS_TOKEN_LEEWAY_SECONDS

title: Avito Ads MCP
